item.title: Dodgers Re-Sign Miguel Rojas To One-Year Contract
item.description: The Los Angeles Dodgers re-signed Miguel Rojas to a one-year, $5.5 million contract for the 2026 season. Rojas represents the first signing this offseason for the Dodgers as the veteran infielder returns to serve as a bench piece for the roster.
